verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL docs state that users can inspect a query's execution plan to identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities. They also say the product gives automatic insights and recommendations when queries run inefficiently, which covers the core of diagnosing slow queries. Coverage is not complete: the pack never names a query profile (per-operator metrics, time and rows per stage) and never ties plan inspection to cost or expense attribution. missing for 10: explicit query-profile documentation with operator-level metrics, evidence of diagnosing expensive (cost/compute) queries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can inspect query profiles and execution plans to find why a query is slow or expensive
